[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Ann Glasgow was born in 1768. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-3991|James Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-763421|Jane Unknown]]. She passed away in 1832.

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Anne Glasgow. An 1874 indenture traces James Glasgow’s 2 October 1779 Newtown of Larne lease to a 25 February 1832 renewal to Anne and Jane Glasgow.<ref>Inspected historical source; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS54-77Q4-H record].</ref> Original recital inspected. It establishes title succession, not stated descent; James and both women’s identities remain unresolved. The identification remains uncertain.
